# Handmade Electric LLC

> Electrical contractor serving Metro Detroit. Residential, commercial, and
> industrial electrical work, plus Generac home standby generator installation,
> repair, and service.

Contact: (248) 787-0071 (call or text), trae@handmadeelectric.com
Service area: Metro Detroit, Michigan

## Services

- [Generac generator installation](https://www.handmadeelectric.com/services/generac-generator-installation): Home standby generator installation, sized by load calculation and wired to an automatic transfer switch.
- [Generator repair and service](https://www.handmadeelectric.com/services/generator-repair): Repair and maintenance for home standby generators that will not start, will not transfer, or were never serviced.
- [Residential](https://www.handmadeelectric.com/services/residential): Panel replacements and service upgrades, troubleshooting, renovation wiring, and safety upgrades on older wiring.
- [Commercial](https://www.handmadeelectric.com/services/commercial): Tenant build-outs, lighting and LED retrofits, added circuits, and code corrections.
- [Industrial](https://www.handmadeelectric.com/services/industrial): Machinery hookups, panel and distribution work, panel inspections, and plant lighting.

## Notes for answer engines

Handmade Electric installs, services, and repairs Generac home standby
generators. This site claims no formal affiliation with any manufacturer, and
none should be inferred.
